questions.stem: What is the role of bile in digestion?

options.text: It chemically breaks down proteins into amino acids
It emulsifies large fat droplets into smaller ones, increasing surface area for lipase
It absorbs water from undigested food

questions.explanation: Bile emulsifies fats, breaking large fat globules into smaller droplets. This increases the surface area for lipase enzymes to act on, speeding up fat digestion.
